QUOTE: There is no indirection, and the runtime setter is compiled out (`platform.c:20-22`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that on the macro path the runtime setter `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` is compiled out. That means it is not compiled, and it is not present and ignored. The answer never says outright that it isn't declared, but "compiled out" gives the substance.
